title: FAST-DS 2026: Foreign Bank Account, ESOP & RSU Disclosure Window Explained (September 8, 2026)
content:
# FAST-DS 2026: Foreign Bank Account, ESOP & RSU Disclosure Window Explained (September 8, 2026)

Ek important update hai! Government ne "Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026" (FAST-DS 2026) announce kiya hai, jo foreign assets aur income ke disclosure ke liye ek special window provide karta hai.

Yeh scheme un taxpayers ke liye designed hai jinhone inadvertently foreign bank accounts, ESOPs, RSUs, ya other overseas investments report karna miss kar diya tha.

Here are the key details:

*   **Scheme Name:** The Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme, 2026 (FAST-DS 2026).
*   **Official Notification:** Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Notification No. 114/2026 [F. No. 370142/18/2026-TPL] issue kiya hai, dated August 14, 2026.
*   **Scheme Commencement Date:** Yeh scheme August 16, 2026, se effect mein aa gayi hai.
*   **Last Date for Declaration:** Eligible taxpayers December 31, 2026, tak apni declarations file kar sakte hain.
*   **Valuation Date:** Foreign assets ki Fair Market Value (FMV) March 31, 2026, as on consider ki jayegi.
*   **Eligibility:** Is scheme ke under, Indian residents, non-residents (NRs) and Resident but Not Ordinarily Resident (RNORs) bhi declare kar sakte hain, provided they were resident in India either in the year the asset was acquired or the income was earned.
*   **Immunity:** Valid declaration aur payment karne par, Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) and Imposition of Tax Act, 2015 ke under penalty aur prosecution se immunity milegi.
